title: Control blocks
subtitle: Stateful loops between rules and devices — filters, thermostats, sequencers. Each block is a virtual device you can chart, wire and command.

errors.load: Failed to load control blocks. Check ApiGateway / AutomationService connection.

confirmDelete: Delete block "{{name}}"? Its virtual device disappears.
empty: No control loops yet — add one from the catalog above and I will keep it running.

stageHint.full: Trusted — its proposals are limited only by the safety floor
stageHint.bounded: Acts carefully — proposals clamped to baseline ± band
stageHint.shadow: Watching only — learns and records proposals, commands nothing

stageOption.shadow: Shadow — watches and learns, never acts
stageOption.bounded: Bounded — acts within a careful band
stageOption.full: Full — trusted up to the safety floor

promote.tooltip: Queue a Shadow → Bounded → Full promotion for approval (Epic 2C)
promote.title: Promote "{{name}}" {{from}} → {{to}}
promote.rationale: Review the backtest scorecard on /models before approving.
promote.queued: Queued a promotion proposal for "{{name}}". Approve it on the Proposals page.

status.runningHint: Ticking every 15 s — last run {{when}}, {{count}} ticks
status.idleHint: Enabled but hasn't produced output yet — check its input wiring
status.stalledHint: Enabled but hasn't ticked recently — the runtime may be down

baseline.label: Baseline setpoint
baseline.desc: Reference the model is nudged around (tracks the loop's live setpoint)

band.label: Band (±)
band.desc: How far the proposal may move from the baseline (Bounded stage)

driftThreshold.label: Drift threshold
driftThreshold.desc: Auto-demote to Shadow when the mean error exceeds this

driftWindowMin.label: Drift window (min)
driftWindowMin.desc: Rolling window used to measure drift

probThreshold.label: On threshold
probThreshold.desc: Probability at/above which the device is commanded on

boundedMargin.label: Bounded margin
boundedMargin.desc: Extra probability margin required to flip (hysteresis)

minDwellMin.label: Min dwell (min)
minDwellMin.desc: Minimum time to hold a state before flipping (anti-chatter)

maxClassStep.label: Max step
maxClassStep.desc: Max positions to move along the value order per change (Bounded stage)

hysteresis.label: Hysteresis (dead-band)
hysteresis.desc: Insensitivity zone around the setpoint so the relay doesn't chatter

coolSetpoint.label: Cooling target
coolSetpoint.desc: Upper target, used only in heat + cool mode

threshold.label: CO₂ threshold
threshold.desc: CO₂ level that calls for ventilation

runMinutes.label: Run time
runMinutes.desc: How long the valve stays open each cycle

offsetMinutes.label: Offset (min)
offsetMinutes.desc: Turn on this many minutes before sunset and off after sunrise

dialog.title: New {{type}}
dialog.name: Name
dialog.outputHelper: Leave empty to only report (no actuation)
dialog.stageDirect: Saving is your explicit approval of the stage; on drift the block auto-demotes back to Shadow

graph.hint: Drag to arrange · draw a wire between ports to bind · double-click a wire to unbind
